content:
Use the full URL of the itemusages endpoint with your bearer token and the required
request headers. You must include a ResetCursor object or the cursor from a previous
response in the request body.
Example item usage request with a
reset cursor
Example item usage request with a
continuing cursor
base_url/api/v2/itemusages
curl --request POST \
--url base_url/api/v2/itemusages \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN' \
$
